With Background
 .Type "Normal"
 .Epsilon "1"
 .Mu "1"
 .XminSpace "0"
 .XmaxSpace "0"
 .YminSpace "0"
 .YmaxSpace "0"
 .ZminSpace "0"
 .ZmaxSpace "0"
End With

 .Xmin "expanded open"
 .Xmax "expanded open"
 .Ymin "expanded open"
 .Ymax "expanded open"
 .Zmin "expanded open"
 .Zmax "expanded open"
 .Xsymmetry "none"
 .Ysymmetry "none"

End With
